lines.text: Every event in your stream is a decision. Granite Time Series models score each one in flight, on Confluent. Poke it.
Here it is in Confluent Cloud. One statement in the Flink S Q L workspace. Press Run, and the results stream back.
Switch to forecast: the next thirty-two steps, with the band.
No training. It has never seen this signal, and it finds the pattern in milliseconds.
Then an agent acts. Forecast, flag, reasoning, purchase order. Under a second, inside Confluent.
Thirty bespoke models become two. Six months become eight weeks. Accuracy from ninety-three to ninety-nine percent.
Every card has its own normal. The odd swipe is held before authorization.
The kiln finds its own setpoint inside the guardrails. The operator approves.
One statement of Flink S Q L. Join the Early Access.
